summary: Listed in the tnlandforms.us Georgia lookout index as a Henry County tower at 33.5427, -84.21143; no build, fate or site record found for this entry.

evidence.supports: index lists a stockridge tower in Henry County with its coordinates
the page is the Georgia lookout towers index

notes_for_editor: Story is about 35 words, far under the 120-word floor, because the only source is one index row (GA163). The index elevation column has no unit label, so no elevation is used. Two web searches turned up one Henry County fire tower, in a 2012 FFLA restoration report (https://firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/cr-restoration-2012.pdf). That report describes a 100-foot Aermotor LS-40 at the abandoned GFC Henry County headquarters off Highway 42, south of McDonough, bought from the GFC for relocation to Reynolds Nature Preserve near Morrow. It is NOT used for this record: the index gives that tower's origin as GA109 greenwood (Henry, 33.40166, -84.13762), which lies south of stockridge's latitude (33.5427), and the index note 'Ron GA109-relocated' sits on the GA423 reynolds entry. So the 2012 tower is probably greenwood, not stockridge, but this is unconfirmed; please check it before linking the two. A city of Stockbridge exists in Henry County and the name may be a misspelling, but no source ties the entry to it. Recommend holding from publication until a second source turns up.
